decisions.note: Pinned race 32/14083 uses the acronym directly. Public Grand Masters race references identify SWBC as Super World Breeders' Cup; keep the compact proper-name acronym unchanged in Vietnamese.

Pinned race 32/3071 and display 33/3071 correspond to the established Japanese TCK女王盃; public race references consistently romanize it as TCK Jo-o Hai. Use the proper-name romanization rather than calquing the Chinese title.
Pinned race 32/4072 and display 33/4072 are the Japanese UHB賞. Preserve UHB and romanize the race-title suffix as Sho instead of translating the Chinese 赏 literally.

Pinned race 32/9700 is a short URA-stage label, but the batch does not establish whether the JP source is the short URA決勝 form or should be normalized with URAファイナルズ. Defer rather than collapse it with the separate full Finals label.

Pinned race 32/9600 is a short URA semifinal label. Public scenario references establish the semifinal concept, but the exact JP display form for this locator is not pinned here; defer the canonical Vietnamese title.
Pinned race 32/9500 is a short URA qualifier label. The concept is clear, but the exact JP display form and whether to include URA Finals in the canonical title remain unresolved, so defer.

Pinned display 33/9700 and race 32/9999 represent a fuller URA Finals final label distinct from the short URA 决赛 source. Defer until the JP locator wording is verified so the two entries are not incorrectly collapsed.
Pinned race 32/14042 uses the acronym directly. Public Grand Masters race references identify WBC as World Breeders' Cup; retain the compact proper-name acronym unchanged.
